defaultPreviewFailures.resolution: Fresh formal and independent market generations use existing native per-launcher QTWEBENGINE_CHROMIUM_FLAGS=--disable-gpu. Actual code and preview workflows repeated.

zoomInputFailure.observed: Preview percent display was not editable. Ctrl+A then 100 modified code view instead, replacing the chapter. Two Undo actions restored code, but the document remained marked unsaved.
zoomInputFailure.resolution: Normal Quit and Discard; read-only saved EPUB hash and contents unchanged before diagnostic launch.

startupTransition.observed: After declining update notice the desktop appeared briefly, then the editor loaded. Screenshot 02 is only a transition.

readOnlyPreparationFailures: Guessed helper/source paths were absent; corrected with rg --files without dependent mutations.
An initial summary read assumed acceptedApplications instead of actual acceptedLocalMarket and raised IndexError; subsequent schema-aware read succeeded.
JSONL diagnostic output was initially parsed as a single JSON document and raised Extra data; each recorded JSON line was parsed separately afterward.
The original freeze command output exceeded context; its 21 actual frozen files were re-read and all size/digest pins verified before signing.
limitations: Only two small one-chapter EPUB2 fixtures with Chinese filenames, ordinary BEFORE→AFTER replacement in code view, ASCII paragraph insertion, actual preview including existing Chinese content, GUI Save As to ASCII paths and explicit fresh-process reopen were verified. Original input/output 1564/1685 bytes; market input/output 1559/1681 bytes. Inputs remained exact original bytes.

EPUB3, multiple chapters, CSS/images/audio/video, plugins/Python execution, metadata/TOC editing, printing, large files, direct Chinese keyboard input and advanced features were not verified. ZIP CRC and XML body checks are not full EPUBCheck/specification validation; synthetic fixtures are not independent applications.

Default preview was blank in two managed GUI processes despite exit zero and saved code. Per-launcher QTWEBENGINE_CHROMIUM_FLAGS=--disable-gpu restored the tested preview through existing native launcher.environment. Exact underlying Wine/Qt/Chromium/GPU defective function is not established. No no-sandbox flag, Core code, global context, program/DLL/runtime/font or working-directory change.

A first-launch newer-version notice was declined normally in default, formal and market generations. That is a non-binding update notice, not an EULA. Unattended startup was not verified; observed newer-version text does not establish current latest upstream release.

Main program GPL-3.0-or-later from fixed src/main.cpp. Installed COPYING.txt matches fixed source COPYING only after 674 CRLF normalizations; raw bytes differ. Full Qt/Chromium/Python/icons and bundled licence closure, OpenPGP/Authenticode verification and reproducibility were not verified.

Guest network download, fresh-machine recipe registration, configuration migration and cross-version upgrades were not verified. Same-version update used verified pre-cache and Store IPC; GUI update/rollback buttons were not verified.

Data preservation covers prior fixed acceptance data, diagnostic pins and new fixed input/output/program/licence/Qt/config/registry pins, not every application filesystem file. Runtime network deny in the plan is not claimed to enforce actual network isolation.
